description: First-pass local CM1 shallow-cumulus reference case for visible cloud liquid water and 2-D scientific visualization.
physical_question: How do lower-atmosphere heating and moisture produce shallow cumulus?
expected_outcome: Shallow cumulus cloud formation with visible cloud liquid water field.

namelist_input_concept.forcing_concept: Surface sensible heating and stronger moisture supply over a moist lower-layer external sounding.
namelist_input_concept.moisture_contrast: Higher near-surface qv and stronger latent moisture flux than dry-failed case.

sounding_profile_concept.format_reference: CM1 input_sounding format: first line surface pressure, theta, qv; following lines z, theta, qv, u, v.
sounding_profile_concept.free_atmosphere: Moist lower layer with drier air above to keep growth shallow.
sounding_profile_concept.final_level_note: Final sounding level is above ztop.

expected_output_files: cm1out_stats.nc or cm1out_stats.dat/ctl depending on CM1 output settings
required_fields: pressure or pressure-derived metadata if available
how_to_ingest: After local output exists, use the #179 CM1 reference adapter path to map selected output into reference-run-v1/reference-frame-v1 data. Do not point the frontend directly at raw CM1 output.
known_limitations: First-pass configuration may need tuning after output inspection.
The generated case should remain shallow; if it grows too deep, adjust forcing or stability before promoting it as a baseline.
The case is a reference contrast, not universal atmospheric truth.
notes: CM1 is offline reference-model output; Cloud Lab does not run CM1 in normal app sessions.
No generated CM1 output is committed with this manifest.
